questions.question: Dr. Ahmed has died suddenly. Dr. Sofia goes to the practice and finds Nadia in tears. Sofia tells her: 'The first thing to do is to secure the practice.' Nadia asks: 'How?' Sofia replies:
options: Lock the accesses and notify patients
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Nadia, the first thing to do is to lock the practice to secure the files and equipment. Then, you need to notify patients with a note on the door.'

questions.question: Karim asks Sofia: 'Who can enter the practice now?' Sofia replies:
options: Only the heirs and mandated professionals
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Karim, only the heirs (you, your mother, your sister) and the professionals you mandate (notary, accountant) can enter. The files and equipment must be protected.'

questions.question: Salma asks Sofia: 'What is an inventory?' Sofia explains that it is:
options: A detailed list of the practice's assets
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Salma, the inventory is a detailed list of everything in the practice: equipment, supplies, files. It is the basis for evaluating the practice's value.'

questions.question: Nadia asks Sofia: 'How to evaluate the value of the practice?' Sofia replies:
options: Estimate the value at a guess
Call upon an accountant or an appraiser
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Nadia, you need to call upon an accountant or a specialized appraiser. They will evaluate the goodwill, equipment, and patient base.'

questions.question: Karim asks: 'What happens to the patient files?' Sofia replies:
options: They are kept and transmitted to the buyer
They are given to the patients
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Karim, patient files are confidential and must be kept. They will be transmitted to the practice's buyer or to the colleagues who will take over the patients.'

questions.question: Salma asks: 'Who inherits the practice?' Sofia replies that according to the law, the heirs are:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Salma, according to Moroccan inheritance law, the heirs are the widow and the children. Each has a share defined by law.'

questions.question: Karim asks: 'Can we sell the practice right away?' Sofia replies:
options: No, you must wait for the settlement of the succession
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Karim, you must wait for the settlement of the succession. This can take several months. The practice cannot be sold before the heirs are clearly identified and the succession is settled.'

questions.question: Nadia asks: 'How to manage patients who call?' Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Nadia, prepare an information message to broadcast on the practice's answering machine. Explain that Dr. Ahmed has passed away and that solutions will be proposed shortly.'

questions.question: Salma asks: 'What is the value of a dental practice?' Sofia explains that it depends on:
options: The goodwill, patient base, and equipment
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Salma, the value of a practice depends on several factors: the goodwill (clientele, reputation), the patient base (number and loyalty), and the equipment.'

questions.question: Karim asks: 'How to find a buyer?' Sofia replies:
options: Through the professional network and consulting firms
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Karim, the best way is through the professional network (colleagues, associations) or through consulting firms specialized in dental practice transfers.'

questions.question: Nadia asks: 'How to manage the practice's debts?' Sofia replies:
options: Settle them with the estate's assets
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Nadia, the practice's debts must be settled with the estate's assets (the practice's money, the sale of equipment). An inventory must be made with the notary.'

questions.question: Salma asks: 'What to do with the dental equipment?' Sofia advises her to:
options: Sell it or transfer it to the buyer
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Salma, the equipment can be sold or transferred to the practice's buyer. A precise inventory and valuation must be made.'

questions.question: Karim asks: 'Can I take over the practice one day?' Sofia replies:
options: Yes, if you obtain your diploma and train in management
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Karim, you can take over the practice if you finish your studies and train in practice management. But you must have the will and the skills.'

questions.question: Nadia asks: 'How to announce the news to patients?' Sofia advises her to:
options: Send a letter or email to patients
Make an announcement in the newspaper
Post a note on the door
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Nadia, send a letter or email to patients to inform them of Ahmed's death. Explain that solutions will be proposed shortly. They need to know.'

questions.question: Salma asks: 'What are the rights of the heirs?' Sofia replies:
options: Rights to the entire estate, including the practice
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Salma, the heirs have rights over the entire estate, including the practice. The notary will help you assert them.'

questions.question: Karim asks: 'How to manage the practice's employees?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Karim, the employees must be informed of the situation. They have rights (indemnities, notice). You must support them and respect the law.'

questions.question: Nadia asks: 'How to manage the stress of this situation?' Sofia advises her to:
options: Surround herself with loved ones and professionals
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Nadia, grief and practice management are two trials. Surround yourself with your family, friends, and professionals (notary, accountant). You are not alone.'

questions.question: Salma asks: 'How long does the settlement of an estate take?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Salma, the settlement of an estate can take several months, even a year, depending on the complexity. You need to be patient and well supported.'

questions.question: Karim asks: 'What to do with already scheduled appointments?' Sofia advises him to:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Karim, you need to contact the patients who had appointments to inform them of the situation. Offer to reschedule or redirect them to another colleague.'

questions.question: Nadia asks: 'How to evaluate the practice's debts?' Sofia replies:
options: By leaving them to the notary
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Nadia, you need to gather all financial documents (invoices, contracts, bank statements) to evaluate the debts. The accountant can help you.'

questions.question: Salma asks: 'Can we sell the practice to a colleague?' Sofia replies:
options: Yes, it's the most common solution
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Salma, selling the practice to a colleague is the most common solution. It allows the transfer of the patient base and know-how.'

questions.question: Karim asks: 'How to know if the practice was profitable?' Sofia advises him to:
options: Analyze the accounts of the last few years
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Karim, to know if the practice was profitable, you need to analyze the accounts of the last few years: turnover, expenses, profits. The accountant can help you.'

questions.question: Nadia asks: 'How to manage grief and the practice at the same time?' Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Nadia, don't handle everything alone. Be supported by professionals for legal and financial aspects. And take time for yourself and your family.'

questions.question: Salma asks: 'What documents are important for the succession?' Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Salma, the important documents are bank accounts, lease contracts, equipment invoices, employment contracts, and of course the will if it exists.'

questions.question: Karim, at the end of this ordeal, says: 'Sofia, thank you. If my father had prepared all this, we wouldn't be lost.' Sofia replies that preparation is essential. Karim concludes:
options: It's too late for my father, but not for others
questions.explanation: Karim: 'Sofia, thank you for everything. If my father had prepared his succession, we wouldn't be in this situation.' Sofia: 'Karim, it's too late for your father, but not for other dentists. Talk about this experience around you.'
